name: Shipnative
tagline: Shipnative — A production-ready React Native + Expo boilerplate that lets developers launch cross-platform mobile apps faster with minimal setup
description: Shipnative — A production-ready React Native + Expo boilerplate that lets developers launch cross-platform mobile apps faster with minimal setup. It ships with pre-wired essentials like authentication, payments, analytics, error tracking, push notifications, internationalisation, theming and responsive UI components, so you can focus on building your unique features instead of repetitive configuration.
